method.control_modes: Four rounding modes crossed with default, DAZ, FTZ and DAZ+FTZ.
method.capture: Prepare inputs, set masked MXCSR control mode, call candidate, read MXCSR, restore initial MXCSR, print only flags/tag/integer counter.
method.scope: Sticky exception flags and control bits plus result tags and iteration counts; numerical equality is checked by the separate semantic fixture.
limitations: Masked exceptions only; signal/trap behavior is not tested.
